weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly articulate the specific contributions of the Daemon framework compared to existing methods.
Claims regarding the theoretical guarantees of the optimization problem are not sufficiently supported by empirical results in the abstract.
The novelty of the Daemon framework is not adequately distinguished from prior work, leading to potential overclaiming.
The scope of the paper as described in the abstract does not fully align with the experimental results presented.
strengths: The paper addresses significant issues in language model decoding, such as exposure bias and distribution mis-specifications.
The proposed Daemon framework offers a novel perspective by framing decoding as a direct optimization problem.
The empirical results demonstrate improvements in various aspects of text generation, providing valuable insights into the framework's effectiveness.
